text: Because by keeping the transmission low, the transmission power low, we can reuse the same frequencies for multiple transmissions and receptions. So the idea here is exactly the following: so the base station will transmit only to few users, and then those users can further disseminate the information using this device-to-device communication, and these device-to-device communications can take place using the same frequencies. That is indeed what we call special reuse of the frequencies, and that's possible because again each transmitter will transmit at low power. Of course, this works if every transmitter and receiver pair is close to each other. So transmitter and receiver must be close to each other, because otherwise, if the transmitter uses a low transmission power, the receiver can receive well only if it's close to the transmitter, right?
